independent_source_review.result: No new blocking boundary issue found: only-NotFound ascent, outer-to-inner retained ancestors, exact-file validation before truncate, same retained directory for replacement/flush, and state publication after successful persistence.
independent_source_review.limitations: Does not introduce global multi-writer exclusion; same-user concurrent state mutation follows the existing owner contract. Source review does not substitute for native qualification.
